content.short: DZap is a multi-chain DeFi automation platform that simplifies complex operations like LP zaps, batch swaps, and cross-chain moves in a single click.
content.description: DZap is a multi-chain DeFi automation and aggregation platform that reduces complex multi-step operations  such as zapping into LP positions, batch token swaps, and cross-chain liquidity movements  into single transactions. Users can convert any token directly into an LP position, bridge assets, or execute multi-step DeFi strategies without managing multiple protocols or transactions. DZap integrates with Mantle to provide streamlined one-click access to the network's DeFi ecosystem.
content.meta: DZap enables seamless DeFi automation and multi-chain liquidity management with one-click execution on Mantle. Discover DZap on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
